items.title: [Fischer] The Lakers, the Bucks, the Grizzlies and the Hornets are currently all over the roster limit of 15 players and must trim their squad before Monday's deadline. The first 3 are exploring potential trades while Charlotte is weighing the locker room value of retaining Pat Connaughton.
items.author: PianoJealous307
items.body_excerpt: Jake Fischer: The Clippers waiving Cam Christie leaves Charlotte, Milwaukee, Memphis and the Lakers as the most pertinent back-of-roster situations NBA personnel are monitoring before Oct. 19. Have heard the Bucks, Lakers and Grizzlies all exploring trades. Hornets have to weigh…
